item.title: CBB Governor Declares Digital Transformation to Boost Financial Stability
item.description: HE Khalid Humaidan, Governor of the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB), affirmed that digital transformation will be a defining factor in strengthening financial stability and unlocking new opportunities for growth.
